page.notes: The title "INDEX HUJUS LIBRI." is printed in spaced capitals below a decorative woodcut border; the border is not transcribed. The first entry's initial "A" is a large decorative capital, joined to "ccipenser" as "Accipenser" with the initial unreadable in part; the reading "Accipenser" is likely but the initial letter is decorative. Entries with italic type are rendered in <l> without markup for legibility. The line "Acetum quod capiti & neruis sit innoxium." runs over to a second line containing only the page number 604. Entry "Acetum in condiendis esciis sale inualidius" is printed as "esciis" in the scan; "Aer eiusq; conditiones" uses a q with superscript stroke for -que. Some letters in entries are blurred; "Æstate" begins with a capital Æ ligature. No column of print numbers beyond those shown. Page number of this index page is not printed; the signature "Rr 3" and the running head "Aer" are at the foot.
